title: Amp mode selector: skeuomorphic hardware knob
note:
Lydia: "Skemorphism in amp model selector". The Choose a Mode dropdown in Amp shows a physical-hardware panel above the plain text list: brushed dark metal plate with corner screws, a big knurled rotary knob with tick marks and LOW / MED / HIGH / ULTRA labels, a glowing green LED on the active setting, a FAST toggle switch next to a $ slot, and a green dot-matrix LCD readout (AGENT GPT-5.6 SOL MED, ORACLE GPT-6 ASTRA X-HIGH). Contrast of the tactile panel against the flat, quiet list below is the good part.

Video: dragging the knob snaps it to each tick with a small overshoot and spring back; the active label lights up in its own color (LOW yellow, MED green, HIGH blue, ULTRA purple) with a glowing dot. The LCD AGENT line changes with a quick character-scramble decode. Knob and list are synced both ways: drag the knob and the list highlight and dropdown pill follow; click "medium" in the list and the knob drives itself back with an ease-in-out and a bounce. FAST is a rigid rocker switch that clacks over, shows a yellow stripe and pops a "2x" badge by the $ slot (tooltip: "Costs 2x the standard rate for this mode"). Raw Models tab swaps the panel for a plain list. Dropdown closes with a fade and slight scale-down. Best moments: knob drag 0:02-0:05, FAST tooltip 0:11, list-driven knob 0:20, FAST toggling 0:22-0:30.
